title: 第二十一章 Penta kill第二十二章 不过是为了活着
content_zh:
我这么老实，这么配合，这么可爱……
他们为什么还要杀我？
王腾不明白！
妈妈说得对，像他这样帅气又可爱的富二代，在外面一定要保护好自己！
外面的世界太危险了！
一不小心，就有生命危险。
他一步步走向带头劫匪，全身瑟瑟发抖……打死他们，一定要打死他们，他们都是穷凶极恶的坏人！
一步！
两步！
越来越近，其他人质投来怜悯的目光。
虽然怜悯，但目光中还有一丝丝庆幸，庆幸先死的人不是他们。
他们也在瑟瑟发抖。
这么可爱的男孩子，那群劫匪都不放过，真是凶残的没边了，警方的直升机怎么还不来？
再不来，后面死的就是他们了！
打死他们！
打死他们！
王腾的心态崩了。
他现在很紧张，手心，后背，额头，都是汗！
除了打死他们，没有其他办法！
三步，四步……很快他距离带头劫匪不足半米。

“快点！
滚过来！”
带头劫匪不耐烦的叫了一声。
够了！
够近了！
不能再等了。
王腾猛然抬起头，眼睛里有血丝。
“你们为什么要逼我？”
“？？”
带头劫匪觉得王腾大概是吓坏了，已经有点语无伦次。
但是下一刻，几个劫匪，还有那些人质都瞪大了眼睛。
带头劫匪更是像见鬼了似的！
他看到了什么？
刚刚明明还像小绵羊一般的人质，这一刻突然化作一头愤怒且疯狂的暴熊。
气势一瞬间不一样了！
“我……”
这一切似慢实快！
王腾抬起头的瞬间，丝毫没有犹豫，心中坚决如铁，脚下猛然重踏。
轰！
瓷砖铺就的地板径直崩碎，碎石四下飞溅。

脚下劲道升腾，将王腾骤然推了出去，王腾犹如射出的箭弩，刹那扑杀至带头劫匪身前。
极限速度，入微级身法，全面爆发！
不足半米距离，直接跨越，所用时间连一秒都不到。
带头劫匪看得见，却跟不上。
content_en:
I am so honest, so cooperative, so cute...
Why are they still killing me?
Wang Teng doesn’t understand!
Mom is right, a handsome and cute rich second generation like him must protect himself outside!
The outside world is too dangerous!
If you are not careful, your life may be in danger.
He walked towards the leader of the robbers step by step, trembling all over... Beat them to death, they must be beaten to death, they are all extremely vicious bad guys!
step!
Two steps!
Getting closer and closer, the other hostages looked at him with pity.
Although he was pitiful, there was still a trace of happiness in his eyes, glad that they were not the ones who died first.
They were also shivering.
Such a cute boy, the group of robbers didn't let him go. He was really cruel and cruel. Why didn't the police helicopter come?
If you don’t come back, they will be the ones who die later!
Beat them to death!
Beat them to death!
Wang Teng's mentality collapsed.
He is very nervous now, his palms, back, and forehead are all sweaty!
There is no other way but to kill them!
Three steps, four steps... Soon he was less than half a meter away from the leading robber.
"Hurry up!
Come here! "
The leading robber shouted impatiently.
Enough!
Close enough!
Can't wait any longer.
Wang Teng suddenly raised his head, his eyes bloodshot.
"Why are you forcing me?"
"??"
The leading robber thought that Wang Teng was probably frightened and was already a little incoherent.
But the next moment, the robbers and the hostages all stared wide-eyed.
The leading robber looked as if he had seen a ghost!
What did he see?
The hostage who looked like a little sheep just now suddenly turned into an angry and crazy bear.
The momentum changed in an instant!
"I..."
All this seems slow but is actually fast!
The moment Wang Teng raised his head, he didn't hesitate at all. His heart was as determined as iron and he stepped hard on his feet.
boom!
The tiled floor shattered and gravel flew everywhere.
The strength under his feet surged, and Wang Teng was suddenly pushed out. Wang Teng was like an arrow and crossbow, and he immediately pounced in front of the leading robber.
Extreme speed, micro-level body skills, full explosion!
The distance was less than half a meter, and it took less than a second to cross it directly.
The leading robber could see, but couldn't follow.
